claims: The Dune saga was created by Frank Herbert.
The Dune saga consists of six original sci-fi novels.
The original novels are centered on the desert planet Arrakis.
The original series starts with Dune (1965).
The original series follows Paul Atreides and his descendants through Dune Messiah, Children of Dune, God Emperor of Dune, Heretics of Dune, and Chapterhouse: Dune.
Dune was published in 1965.
Dune introduces Paul Atreides.
In Dune, Paul Atreides' family takes control of the desert planet Arrakis.
Dune Messiah was published in 1969.
Dune Messiah examines the consequences of Paul Atreides' ascension.
Children of Dune was published in 1976.
Children of Dune follows Paul Atreides' children, Leto II and Ghanima.
God Emperor of Dune was published in 1981.
God Emperor of Dune features a transformed, long-reigning Leto II.
Heretics of Dune was published in 1984.
Heretics of Dune is set centuries later.
Heretics of Dune focuses on the Bene Gesserit.
Dune was published in 1985.
Dune concludes Frank Herbert's original series.
Brian Herbert is Frank Herbert's son.
Following Frank Herbert's death, Brian Herbert and Kevin J. Anderson wrote numerous prequels and sequels.
Brian Herbert and Kevin J. Anderson wrote Hunters of Dune (2006).
Brian Herbert and Kevin J. Anderson wrote Sandworms of Dune (2007).
Hunters of Dune and Sandworms of Dune continue the original storyline.
Legends of Dune Trilogy consists of The Butlerian Jihad, The Machine Crusade, The Battle of Corrin.
Great Schools of Dune Trilogy consists of Sisterhood of Dune, Mentats of Dune, Navigators of Dune.
Prelude to Dune Trilogy consists of House Atreides, House Harkonnen, House Corrino.
Caladan Trilogy consists of The Duke of Caladan, The Lady of Caladan, The Heir of Caladan.
